teaching.theme: Food & Healthy Eating（食物与健康饮食）
key_points: 食物分类：fruits / vegetables / meat / dairy
喜好表达：I like / I don't like / My favorite is
健康表达：good for you / bad for you
How many / How much 疑问句

timeline.title: 开场 · 复习上节课
timeline.detail: What did you eat for breakfast today?

timeline.title: 喜好与健康
timeline.detail: Vegetables are good for you / Candy is bad for you / My favorite fruit is mango

timeline.title: How many / How much
timeline.detail: How many apples do you eat? → I eat two apples a day

timeline.title: 总结
timeline.detail: What is your favorite food? Why?

strengths: 食物词汇丰富，能自主列举
喜好表达 I like / My favorite is 使用流畅
good for you / bad for you 概念清晰
weaknesses: How many vs How much 区分不清（可数/不可数）
回答 Why 时缺少 because
performance.teacher_comment: Mera 对食物话题很感兴趣，课堂参与度高。how many/much 的区分是下阶段重点。

mastered: 常见食物词汇（apple / banana / carrot / chicken / milk）
good for you / bad for you
needs_review: How many（可数）vs How much（不可数）
because 回答 why 问题

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What did you eat for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: How many eggs did you eat?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: How much milk do you drink every day?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.correction: How much milk — milk is uncountable.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.correction: I like mangoes because they are sweet.

sentence_making.prompt: 用 because 说明为什么喜欢某种食物
sentence_making.example_answer: I like apples because they are sweet and good for me.

sentence_making.prompt: How many 造句：oranges / eat / day
sentence_making.example_answer: How many oranges do you eat a day?

qa_practice.question: What is your favorite fruit?
qa_practice.answer: My favorite fruit is mango because it is sweet.

qa_practice.question: Are vegetables good for you?
qa_practice.answer: Yes, vegetables are good for me.

qa_practice.question: How many apples do you eat a week?
qa_practice.answer: I eat three apples a week.
